messages:
jin: CI is failing on chart 'inference-agent' in the values schema stage, seen this in the helmfile pipeline.
jin: ct/helm lint shows a schema validation error for values.schema.json: `must match exactly one schema in oneOf`
jin: full error:
```text
ERROR: values.schema.json: data should match exactly one schema in oneOf
  at #/spec/featureFlags
  schema path: /oneOf
```
maria: ok can you paste the schema and the values that trigger it?
jin: here's the relevant schema slice (simplified):
```json
"featureFlags": {
  "oneOf": [
    { "type": "boolean" },
    { "type": "object", "properties": { "enabled": { "type": "boolean" }, "ttl": { "type": "integer" } }, "required": ["enabled"] }
  ]
}
```
jin: and our values (from overlays/prod.yaml):
```yaml
featureFlags:
  enabled: true
```
sam: the problem is that `{"enabled": true}` matches both the boolean schema? Wait boolean vs object — shouldn't be both.
maria: it matches the object schema, but some JSON schema validators coerce `true` when using YAML parsing into boolean, while our CI validator appears to be treating the root value differently. I've seen this when anchors/merge keys or when values are interpolated by helm-templates before validation.
ops-oncall: are we running schema validation against the rendered values.yaml (post-helm template) or the raw values file? k8s-ci-bot: our ct config runs schema validation on the merged values.yaml before templating by default (ct --validate-values). That's the source of truth.
jin: right — but helmfile does value merges with overlays and some environments use yaml anchors that end up rendering as `true` vs `{enabled: true}` depending on merge order.
maria: short-term fix: change oneOf -> anyOf and add an explicit type discriminator or require a distinguishing property. e.g.
```json
"featureFlags": {
  "anyOf": [
    { "type": "boolean" },
    { "type": "object", "properties": { "enabled": { "type": "boolean" }, "ttl": { "type": "integer" } }, "required": ["enabled"], "additionalProperties": false }
  ]
}
```
sam: anyOf will silence the "exactly one" check but could hide ambiguous inputs — I prefer a safer pattern: always normalize values to an object and deprecate bare boolean shorthand.
jin: agree — a migration plan is fine. For now CI needs to stop blocking pipelines. Can we adjust ct or the schema as a short-term patch?
maria: propose this two-step approach:
1) update values.schema.json -> replace `oneOf` with `anyOf` + additionalProperties:false to reduce accidental matches
2) create a lint rule in the repo that warns if featureFlags is a bare boolean in overlay files (yaml linter or pre-commit script)
sam: also add a tiny helm helper in _helpers.tpl to coerce booleans into object in templates:
```gotemplate
{{- define "featureFlags.normalize" -}}
{{- if or (kindIs "bool" .Values.featureFlags) (eq .Values.featureFlags true) (eq .Values.featureFlags false) -}}
  {"enabled": {{ .Values.featureFlags | toJson }} }
{{- else -}}
  {{ .Values.featureFlags | toJson }}
{{- end -}}
{{- end -}}
```
jin: that helper could avoid runtime drift — good idea. CI change: k8s-ci-bot can we flip ct validation to ignore this specific rule for next 24 hours while we patch?
k8s-ci-bot: I can add a temporary override: `ct --validate-values --skip-values-validation-paths "**/featureFlags"` for the helmfile job. Will post a PR.
jin: thanks — also note this surfaced because gpu nodeSelector templates use the same overlay pattern, we've had drift with nodeSelector.gpu becoming a string in some envs and failing kube-scheduler affinity.
maria: please open a quick follow-up issue: title "normalize chart boolean/object shorthands and audit overlays" and assign to eng-platform. Put a checklist: update schema, add helper, add pre-commit linter, update CT config, migrate overlays.
ops-oncall: FYI if this had hit prod we might have seen pods scheduled on non-gpu nodes and cost spike. Keep me posted.
sam: I'll draft the PR for the schema change + helper. jin can you collect the overlay files that contain featureFlags shorthand? I can rewrite them in the PR.
jin: done — pushed a branch with a failing CI run and pasted links in the PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Created PR #412: "helm: relax oneOf -> anyOf for featureFlags + normalize helper" — CI will run.
k8s-ci-bot: CI override applied for 24h on branch/PR 412. Remember to remove once migration done.
ops-oncall: once merged, monitor the dedicated GPU fleet metrics (node allocation + preemption) for 2 deploy cycles.
